scenes.title: Yogurt Shakes and Cash Envelopes
scenes.summary: Muranishi's eager new assistant arrives at the new studio with yogurt shakes, gets a lecture on using imagination to please everyone, and watches 140 million yen in appearance fees handed out.

scenes.title: Ten Thousand Applicants and New Stars
scenes.summary: A shy newcomer actress tells Muranishi and Kuroki she joined after admiring Kuroki's debut hit, and Muranishi unveils his exclusive roster of actresses to the press.
scenes.location: upstairs dressing room and press hall

scenes.title: Grapes in the Satellite Lobby
scenes.summary: When the satellite company President abruptly cancels their meeting, Muranishi hands out fresh grapes in the corporate lobby and scolds him over the phone until the bank Section Chief walks out.

scenes.title: Shakedown in the Freezing Cold
scenes.summary: Walking a young hostess home, Toshi tries to stop an older woman shaking her down for monthly cash in the freezing cold, only to learn the woman is her own debt-ridden mother.

scenes.title: White Symbolizes Innocence
scenes.summary: At a wardrobe fitting, Kuroki praises a shy newcomer's taste after she selects an elegant outfit for Kuroki's commercial shoot, and agrees to mentor her before her debut.

scenes.title: Late-Night Coffee in the Editing Room
scenes.summary: Kuroki brings coffee to the junior director editing late at night, reassures him she will make more videos, and shares a quiet moment with Muranishi as he asks her to stay their poster girl.

scenes.title: Piranhas in the Tank
scenes.summary: Detective Takei warns Furuya over a tank of piranhas that ruthless foreign gangsters are invading the nightlife district, then taunts Toshi outside about Kawada and Muranishi splitting up.

scenes.title: A Cosmic Broadcast on Television
scenes.summary: After his assistant wishes someone would sell a broadcast station cheap, Muranishi spots a religious order's cosmic television program, asks how much cash they have on hand, and heads to its headquarters.

scenes.title: Pitching Erotica to a Religious Order
scenes.summary: While Kuroki questions a commercial stylist trying to change her image, Muranishi visits a wealthy religious order's headquarters and boldly asks its Proprietor to sell him their satellite facility.
scenes.location: commercial studio and religious order hall

scenes.title: One Point Nine Billion in Cash
scenes.summary: Kuroki confides that she is only her true self when filming with Muranishi, while Muranishi buys the religious order's 1.9-billion-yen earth station with 500 million down plus a 100-million-yen donation.
scenes.location: dressing room and religious order hall

scenes.title: Directing Just Like Muranishi
scenes.summary: A female staff director channels Muranishi's exact fiery rhythm on set as Kuroki watches nostalgically, while the stunned satellite President learns Muranishi bought an entire earth station.
scenes.location: film set and satellite company office

scenes.title: The Twenty-Minute Bridge Stunt
scenes.summary: Muranishi unveils an audacious guerrilla plan to block off a major suspension bridge with eight limousines and two helicopters to shoot a debut satellite film in under twenty minutes.

scenes.title: The Eternal Virgin on Live Television
scenes.summary: After Muranishi tells Kuroki he wants spectacle over quality for their first satellite film, Kuroki dazzles a live television debate and announces her own comeback video, forcing Muranishi to change course.
